steps.message: Create a playlist in Retro Music titled "World Music Tour 990" with the following songs, in order: Hidden Paths, Bright Lights. Then export the playlist to the Downloads directory on the device.

Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i retro; echo '---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/media --projection _id:title:_data --where \"title='Hidden Paths' OR title='Bright Lights'\"; echo '---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i retro; echo '---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/media --projection _id:title:_data --where \"title='Hidden Paths' OR title='Bright Lights'\"; echo '---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "echo '---DOWNLOADS---'; ls -la /storage/emulated/0/Download 2>/dev/null; echo '---PLAYLIST FILES---'; find /storage/emulated/0 -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*.m3u' -o -iname '*.m3u8' -o -iname '*.pls' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 20"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "echo '---DOWNLOADS---'; ls -la /storage/emulated/0/Download 2>/dev/null; echo '---PLAYLIST FILES---'; find /storage/emulated/0 -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*.m3u' -o -iname '*.m3u8' -o -iname '*.pls' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 20""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "content delete --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --where \"name='World Music Tour 990'\"; content insert --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --bind name:s:'World Music Tour 990'; pid=$(content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name --where \"name='World Music Tour 990'\" | sed -n 's/.*_id=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1); echo PLAYLIST_ID=$pid; content insert --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists/$pid/members --bind audio_id:i:1000000037 --bind play_order:i:1; content insert --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists/$pid/members --bind audio_id:i:1000000031 --bind play_order:i:2; echo '---MEMBERS---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists/$pid/members --projection audio_id:play_order; f='/storage/emulated/0/Download/World Music Tour 990.m3u'; printf '%s\n' '#EXTM3U' '/storage/emulated/0/Music/Hidden Paths.mp3' '/storage/emulated/0/Music/Bright Lights.mp3' > \"$f\"; am broadcast -a android.intent.action.MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE -d file://\"$f\"; echo '---EXPORTED---'; ls -l \"$f\"; cat \"$f\"; am force-stop code.name.monkey.retromusic"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "content delete --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --where \"name='World Music Tour 990'\"; content insert --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --bind name:s:'World Music Tour 990'; pid=$(content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name --where \"name='World Music Tour 990'\" | sed -n 's/.*_id=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1); echo PLAYLIST_ID=$pid; content insert --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists/$pid/members --bind audio_id:i:1000000037 --bind play_order:i:1; content insert --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists/$pid/members --bind audio_id:i:1000000031 --bind play_order:i:2; echo '---MEMBERS---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists/$pid/members --projection audio_id:play_order; f='/storage/emulated/0/Download/World Music Tour 990.m3u'; printf '%s\n' '#EXTM3U' '/storage/emulated/0/Music/Hidden Paths.mp3' '/storage/emulated/0/Music/Bright Lights.mp3' > \"$f\"; am broadcast -a android.intent.action.MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE -d file://\"$f\"; echo '---EXPORTED---'; ls -l \"$f\"; cat \"$f\"; am force-stop code.name.monkey.retromusic""
